tool.name: DICOMweb: Register Series
tool.description: Verify and register a DICOM Series from a DICOMweb source

param.name: source_id
param.label: Source ID
param.help: Must match an ID in the catalog

tool.help: Queries the specified DICOMweb source (QIDO-RS) to verify the existence of the Study/Series and fetches metadata. Creates a Lightweight DICOM Reference dataset used for downstream import or visualization.
